title: A first sign-in from Reddit, X, YouTube, the blog or a helpdesk reply keeps its utm_medium instead of turning into other
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (no stand, no database, no listener needed) run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/sign-in-source.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`, and the test line whose name starts with `signInSource reads only the four utm keys`.
expect: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `fail 0`.

`signInSource reads only the four utm keys, holds medium to the closed set, and is null when empty` passes: utm_medium social (reddit, x), video (youtube), owned (blog) and helpdesk each read back as themselves, and newsletter still reads as other.
evidence: tracy-marketing publishes about 200 links with utm_medium=social (Reddit, X), plus video (YouTube) and owned (blog); before this change each became medium other on /ops/signals.
fence: signInSource holds medium to MEDIUMS; anything outside still becomes other. Unit test only: not a proof that the Signals screen draws the new buckets.
